hooks.command: fp=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [[ "$fp" =~ (src/lib/narrative|tests/units/narrative|scenarios/fixtures|src/lib/zschemas/scripted-scenario|src/lib/scenario/(pb-id|validate-references|persist-scripted)) ]]; then cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-/Users/eric/Code/svelte-revolution}" && out=$(pnpm -s test:narrative --reporter=dot 2>&1); status=$?; if [[ $status -eq 0 ]]; then echo "[narrative-tests] ✅ green ($(echo \"$out\" | grep -Eo '[0-9]+ passed' | head -1))"; else echo "[narrative-tests] ❌ FAILED after editing $fp"; echo "$out" | tail -25; fi; fi
